scientific_integrity: The asserted contribution is the equivariant irreducible decomposition, not the already known homotopy type. Finite checks corroborate rather than replace the all-n proof.
scientific_limitations: Rational symmetric-group modules only; the integral module structure and other domination thresholds are outside the claim. The previously known nonequivariant wedge theorem is a premise; unindexed equivalent literature remains a residual risk.
title: Stable Specht decomposition of \(H_2(D_{n,n-2};\mathbb Q)\)
